be 动词 am / is / are · 典型例句(第3轮): Use am/is/are to express identity and state: I use am; singular/he/she/it uses is; plural/you/we/they use are.本课为典型例句练习,核心:The subject and the be verb must agree。

The first-person singular I always pairs with am|Singular nouns and he/she/it use is|Plural nouns and you/we/they use are|be + adjective expresses state|be + noun expresses identity|In the negative add not after be, in questions move be before the subject
I be a new student.|I is a new student.|I am a new student.|I are a new student.
column4: The subject and the be verb must agree。正确句:I am a new student.
